purpose: Challenge the backend-neutral L4 boundary with a language-neutral symbolic corpus before any persistent implementation is declared conformant or canonical.

referenceHarness.role: prove that the current accepted in-memory semantics can be observed through the proposed backend-neutral surface without exposing numeric LinkRef values as ontology

surfaceUnderChallenge.bootstrap: explicit closed-graph import outside normal realize

challengeVectors: missing exact pair find with unchanged snapshot
second exact pair realize returns same logical binding and unchanged topology
delete outer then inner succeeds without cascade
self-cyclic seed graph remains observable after bootstrap
multi-node structural denotation commits all nodes or none
missing structural anchor exposes no partial links
raw/quoted denotation never becomes implicit realize command

requiredVectors: find after reopen returns the same logical pair relation after handle normalization
idempotent realize after reopen does not duplicate exact pair
failed or interrupted multi-node commit exposes committed pre-state or post-state, never a half-state

implementationVetoes: find or poles realize missing links
persistent physical address is compared as MTS identity
reference AnumMemory is rewritten merely to fit a candidate adapter API

pmmNextStep.role: candidate persistent implementation behind an adapter

releaseGate: reference harness passes the portable symbolic corpus
challenge remains unlinked from accepted mts-contract
at least one persistent adapter passes all applicable portable and persistence vectors
handle normalization proves topology rather than allocator address is the observable identity
publish an explicit accepted versioned backend contract only after both reference and persistent evidence exist
